purpose: One fast UI path. Tailwind + Lucide, functional first, no style-skill ceremony.

rules.style_selection: Tailwind CSS + Lucide React. Reuse the existing dark neutral/cyan system in Shannons_diary/frontend/src/index.css.
rules.product_ui: Every interactive surface has 4 states: idle, loading, error, empty. Error and empty are never faked as success.
rules.accessibility: Touch targets >= 44px, WCAG AA contrast, visible focus rings.
